description: Cross-language contract for telemetry redaction (SEC-003/SEC-009, ADR 0006). Only allowlisted attributes are emitted; secret-shaped attributes are dropped; the agent session id is hashed at info level and retained in plaintext only at error level; exception messages are scrubbed of secret-shaped substrings.

cases.description: Given a mixed attribute set, only allowlisted attributes are emitted; secret-shaped attributes are dropped.
At info level the agent session id is hashed, never emitted in plaintext.
At error level the agent session id is retained in plaintext for troubleshooting.
Secret-shaped substrings are scrubbed from free-form exception messages before they are attached to spans.
